description: Tenant-partitioned runtime stores: physicalScopedPath (<base>/tenants/<slug>/...) call sites under active/shared/runtime/ that the gate cannot attribute to an offboarding PHYSICAL_* base in libs/core/scope-offboarding.ts. 'unresolved' entries name a base expression the static scan cannot evaluate (say what it resolves to and why it is covered); 'bases' entries name a resolved runtime base that is deliberately not offboarded. Gate: tests/tenant-runtime-store-registration.test.ts.

unresolved.reason: The feedback ledger base: active/shared/runtime/feedback-loop (covered, PHYSICAL_TENANT_LEARNING_ROOTS) unless the KYBERION_KNOWLEDGE_FEEDBACK_DIR test/runtime override points elsewhere.
pathResolver.shared('runtime/feedback-loop') (covered, PHYSICAL_TENANT_LEARNING_ROOTS) unless the KYBERION_KNOWLEDGE_FEEDBACK_DIR override is set.
Only reached when the KYBERION_KNOWLEDGE_FEEDBACK_DIR override lies outside active/shared/runtime/feedback-loop (the default base takes the feedbackRoot branch, which is covered).
dirname of active/shared/runtime/intent-contract-memory.json = active/shared/runtime (covered: <runtime>/tenants/<slug>) unless KYBERION_INTENT_CONTRACT_MEMORY_RUNTIME_PATH overrides it.
dirname of knowledge/personal/contextual-intent-memory.json: a knowledge-tier path, not active/shared/runtime (tier-guarded as knowledge/personal).
Surface async-channel bases under active/shared/coordination/channels/<surface>/ (PHYSICAL_CHANNEL_ROOT, offboarded per surface), not active/shared/runtime.
One-shot migration tool that MOVES legacy flat records into the existing physical bases it enumerates; it creates no new store.
